name: quoteproof
description: Commit synthetic quote revisions with a direct Supra HBAR/USD snapshot on Hedera Testnet, then verify the local evidence and public receipt independently.

envVars.description: Optional Hedera Testnet JSON-RPC URL. Defaults to public HashIO.
QuoteProof contract address after your Hedera Testnet deployment.

steps.text: The unsigned Supra preview and local evidence flow work immediately. A funded Hedera Testnet account and NEXT_PUBLIC_QUOTEPROOF_ADDRESS are required for a real anchor transaction.
